audience.brapi: Breeding software that speaks BrAPI reads trials straight from the platform.
audience.miappe: Plant phenotyping repositories keep trials where other researchers can find and reuse them.
audience.openaire-floor: A published dataset gets a DOI anyone can cite, and OpenAIRE lists it with open research.
audience.crop-ontology: Traits with shared names can be compared with the same traits in other trials.
audience.common-greenhouse-ontology: Greenhouse setups with shared names can be compared across facilities.
audience.ogc-sensorthings: Sensor platforms let other tools read the readings as they arrive.

companion.afterPublishing: {{name}} follows once a dataset is published.

why.unit-without-greenhouse-term: Greenhouse vocabulary names greenhouse and growth chamber setups, and this trial's unit, {{unitName}}, carries no greenhouse term.
why.under-evaluation: Sensor platforms would take live sensor readings, and the platform has not decided whether to offer that yet.
